name: Shivgad Fort (Kolhapur)
description: Shivgad is a lesser-known but historically significant fort in the Kolhapur region. It played a strategic role in the Maratha defense system and offers scenic views of the surrounding hills. The fort is mostly in ruins but is a peaceful destination for history enthusiasts and trekkers.

routes.name: Shivgadwadi Route
routes.description: Gentle climb through forested slopes and open meadows.

landmarks.name: Ruined Bastions
landmarks.description: Remnants of the fort's defensive walls and bastions.

landmarks.name: Viewpoints
landmarks.description: Scenic views of the Kolhapur hills and valleys.

history.significance: Strategic outpost in the Kolhapur region, part of the Maratha defense network.

reviews: Quiet and offbeat fort, perfect for a peaceful trek.
Not much remains except the bastions, but the views are great.
Carry your own water and snacks.
